title: Keto Turnip Fold
description: An earthy and flaky keto-friendly Australian dish featuring finely grated turnips folded into a creamy avocado base.
instructions: Grate the turnips into very fine pieces, ensuring they are evenly sized for uniform texture.
In a blender or food processor, combine grated turnips with half of the avocado and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
Add butter or keto spread to the blended turnip mixture and blend again until well combined and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Optionally, stir in the remaining avocado for extra creaminess and texture.
Fold the turnip base gently into the grated turnips before serving if desired.
